description:
How much was liquidated. Without a coin: every market ranked by liquidated
USD over the window, long vs short. With a coin: long and short liquidations
per time bucket. Windows that the node missed are listed under `gaps` -- those
are missing data, not quiet periods.

coin.description: One market, for a time series; omit for a ranking of markets
coin.title: Coin

interval.description: Bucket size for the time series; chosen from hours if omitted
interval.title: Interval

name: liquidation_totals
title: Liquidation totals
